title: Go, conditional go, or no-go?
prompt: The wiki passes the fit check. Two risks are open: the stale sandbox and the unmatched contractors. Security has not approved hosting. What is your call?

options.text: Go now and resolve the open risks during acceptance testing.
options.feedback: Hosting determines secrets, scheduling, and networking, so it is chosen before you build.

options.text: Conditional go: build starts when hosting is approved, the sandbox is refreshed, and the identity decision is signed.
options.feedback: Right. Each condition removes a failure you would otherwise meet later, in security review, validation, or permissions testing.

options.text: No-go until the source adds activity data.
options.feedback: Missing activity weakens ranking, but it does not block a correct connector.

takeaway: A conditional go names the conditions and who closes each one.
